Players Committee card image of [[Silence Is Golden (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Your droids are destiny +1. Once per turn, if you just drew a non-[Presence] droid for destiny, may take that droid into hand. Once per turn, may ▼ Droid Workshop, Forced Servitude, Incinerator, or Wuher. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/silenceisgolden.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/silenceisgolden.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
